pending_interview.question: You are leading an AI platform team whose roadmap is heavily subscribed — you have more high-priority requests from internal business stakeholders than your team can realistically deliver in the next two quarters. Two senior stakeholders, each with genuine executive backing, each believe their initiative is the most important one and should come first. Both have escalated to your manager, who has asked you to resolve this without her having to make the call. Walk me through how you would handle it, from the moment you get that request to the point where a decision is made and communicated.
